validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="name" expr="'Ada'"/></datamodel>
  <final id="a">
    <onentry>
      <log expr="concat('Hello, ' $name)"/>
    </onentry>
  </final>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: xpath syntax error in `expr`: expected `,` between the function's arguments, found `$name`
notes: an expression that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` whenever it is evaluated
diagnostics.help: separate function arguments with `,`, for example `concat($first, ' ', $last)`
spec_references: SCXML CR 2014 §C.3 The XPath Data Model
